reason: I can get a bottle of magnesium glycinate for way less per day, and I take it at home anyway so I don't need it in a sachet. $0.83 to $1 a day for the convenience isn't worth it to me.
objection: Why pay double for one form of magnesium in a foil packet when other brands put several forms in one capsule for cheaper?
would_change_my_mind: A flash sale or coupon that gets a box down to about $15 to $18, or a 3-box deal under $0.60 a day.
